modules.title: Introduction to Pillars of Islam
modules.html:
Shahadah, Salat, Zakat, Sawm and Hajj: their meaning, conditions and importance in a Muslim's life. This section covers introduction to pillars of islam.

Key points

  • How many pillars of Islam are there — 5.
  • The most important pillar of Islam is — Shahadah.
  • The first Caliph in Islam was _____. — Abu Bakr As-Siddiq.
  • Which Caliph oversaw the expansion of Islam into Persia, Egypt, and the Levant — Umar b. Khattab.
  • The 'Fara'id' refers to _____ in Islam. — Obligatory duties.

Worked examples

Q: How many pillars of Islam are there?
A: 5 — Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: 5.

Q: The most important pillar of Islam is?
A: Shahadah — Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Shahadah.

quiz.q: How many pillars of Islam are there?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: 5.

quiz.q: The most important pillar of Islam is?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Shahadah.

quiz.q: The first Caliph in Islam was _____.
quiz.solution: Abu Bakr was elected as the leader of the Muslim community immediately after the death of the Prophet (SAW).

quiz.q: Which Caliph oversaw the expansion of Islam into Persia, Egypt, and the Levant?
quiz.solution: Umar (RA) was the great administrator and conqueror under whose rule the Islamic empire expanded most rapidly.

quiz.q: The 'Fara'id' refers to _____ in Islam.
quiz.solution: Fara'id (singular: Fard) are the mandatory acts commanded by Allah, such as the Five Pillars.

quiz.q: The first Pillar of Islam is:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Kalimat Shahada.

quiz.q: Who was the first Caliph of Islam?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Abu Bakr as-Siddiq.

quiz.q: Who was the first male convert to Islam?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Abu Bakr.

quiz.q: Who was the first Muezzin of Islam?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Bilal ibn Rabah.

quiz.q: Ribs usually refers to interest, which is ____ in Islam.
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Forbidden (Haram).

quiz.q: The first battle in Islam was:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Badr.

quiz.q: Who was the first adult male to embrace Islam?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Abu Bakr as-Siddiq.

quiz.q: The first Caliph of Islam was:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Abu Bakr.

quiz.q: The word "Islam" literally means?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Submission.

quiz.q: The first woman to accept Islam was?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Khadijah.

quiz.q: The first child to accept Islam was?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Ali bin Abi Talib.

quiz.q: Eating pork is ___ in Islam?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Haram.

quiz.q: Haram means:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Forbidden.

quiz.q: The Kaaba is located in:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Makkah.

quiz.q: The Treaty of Hudaibiyah was a peace agreement between Muslims and:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Quraish of Makkah.

quiz.q: The Year of the Elephant is the year:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: The Prophet was born.

quiz.q: Fasting is prescribed in the month of:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Ramadan.

quiz.q: The waiting period for a widow is:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: 4 months and 10 days.

quiz.q: Backbiting is like:
options: Eating the flesh of a dead brother
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Eating the flesh of a dead brother.

quiz.q: The Holiest Mosque is in:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Makkah.

quiz.q: The standing at ___ is the most essential rite of Hajj.
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Arafat.

quiz.q: How many times a day do Muslims face the Ka'bah for prayer?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: 5 times.

quiz.q: Al-Khulafa ar-Rashidun refers to:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: The Rightly Guided Caliphs.

quiz.q: Ijma means:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Consensus of scholars.

quiz.q: The Quran was revealed in the month of:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Ramadan.

quiz.q: Mount Arafat is visited during:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Hajj.

quiz.q: Jinn created from:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Smokeless Fire.

quiz.q: Alcohol is:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Haram.

quiz.q: Halal meat must be:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Slaughtered with Allah's name.

quiz.q: Sawm:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: Ramadan.

quiz.q: 4th Caliph:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: Ali.

quiz.q: Halal:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: Permitted.

quiz.q: Ihram:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: Hajj Dress.

quiz.q: Dry ablution using clean sand is called?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Tayammum.

quiz.q: Sawm (Fasting) is compulsory in the month of?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Ramadan.

quiz.q: "Al-Rahman" means?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: The Most Merciful.

quiz.q: His father's name was?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Abdullah.

quiz.q: The Battle of Badr took place in the year ___ A.H.?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: 2.

quiz.q: The Sokoto Caliphate in Nigeria was founded by?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Usman dan Fodio.
